scientific_integrity: The unbounded-dimensional theorem uses a direct group-inverse identity and analytic inequalities. The finite exact checker supplies corroborating, not exhaustive, verification.
scientific_limitations: Only strongly connected, forward-only directed cycles with positive rates; only the uniform four-cycle receives a complete finite-step positivity interval. Stronger graph classes, nonconservative dynamics and internal stages are not covered. Bibliographic uniqueness and independent audit are not established.
title: Fourth-order Gauss positivity on directed Markov cycles: the exact all-step classification
